QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] Defeat the Lion King
QuestInfo.0: Von Leon the Lion King became the Black Mage's Commander out of revenge, this cannot continue. Talk to #bLuden#k the ghost in #b#m211060800##k.
QuestInfo.1:
Head to the Audience Room and defeat the transformed Lion King on easy mode. He once was a normal warrior, only skilled with the sword, but no one knows what he's capable of now under the influence of the Black Mage. If you're alone, this will be a tough battle.\n\n#o8840000##r #a31711##k

#b#e#rEasy Mode#b Von Leon meets the clear requirement.#b
QuestInfo.2: You defeated Von Leon the Lion King.

0.0: I lost my life long ago, but I still maintain my loyalty to this kingdom. We can't bring back the past, but we can't just sit and watch evil take this place.
0.1: Please, I beg you... Please #bdefeat my king#k. Go to the #bAudience Room#k and #reliminate the monster who was once my king#k. This is for him...

yes.0: The king I knew was a normal warrior who was skilled with a sword, but not much else. Under the Black Mage's influence, I don't know what he's capable of. I doubt you can defeat him on your own. I recommend you gather some people to help you.\r\n#b#e#rEasy Mode#b Von Leon meets the clear requirement.#b

1.0: Did you defeat him? I see... I feel saddened for my king. I don't know how it came to this. I used to serve the king with utmost loyalty...

yes.0: This is all because of the Black Mage. You haven't completely defeated the king, you know. With the power of the Black Mage, he is only temporarily weakened.
yes.1: The source of his power is tied to the Black Mage, so he will not truly fall until that power has been driven from his body.
